gate_type: ACCELERATED IMPLEMENTATION GATE — Composition Graph + Coordinator + Typed Boundary Ports (G4)
objective: Implement the smallest reusable production foundation for hierarchical scopes + connectivity graph + executable participants + typed boundary exchange + deterministic coordinator, preserving the frozen rule that the Coordinator is a composition service, not a domain simulation engine. Allow independently-owned executable scopes with different internal mechanisms/cadences to participate deterministically WITHOUT direct cross-scope state mutation. Composition/connectivity is a separate graph from the containment tree; cycles are allowed (no DAG requirement); exchange only through declared typed boundary ports via detached/immutable staged transfers; deterministic ordering independent of declaration/registration order; container-only scopes own no runtime participant; no PIM canonical identity fabrication; no false rollback claims; do not rewrite AssyLineRuntime.
explicit_non_objectives: No G5 TIPA Workspace / ASSY federation migration
No G7 run-control UI/API, replay orchestration, restart policy
No G8 regression-baseline program beyond mandatory G4 regression
No G9 semantic binding / PIM resolver
No numerical coupling solver / algebraic-loop iteration
No snapshot/checkpoint restore or transactional rollback of child runtimes
forbidden_actions: Implement G5+ (ASSY federation, UI, run-control, semantic binding, SH-WTP)
Require a DAG / use acyclicity as a correctness shortcut
Claim transactional rollback of child runtime state that does not exist
Reach into participant domain state outside the participant/boundary contract
Implement numerical algebraic-loop solving or a global timestep/scheduler
Delete or reduce existing tests silently
stop_conditions: Safe solution requires a single universal engine/timestep/scheduler
Existing G1/G2/G3 authority contracts must be broken
Correct cyclic composition requires choosing a domain-specific numerical solver
Typed port semantics cannot be separated from PIM canonical semantic ownership
Compatibility requires breaking PlantGraph/current core ports rather than an additive seam
Failure semantics require transactional rollback/checkpoint support not present

acceptance_criteria.description: Generic cross-scope composition graph exists and is distinct from containment
Graph cycles supported safely at staged exchange boundaries
Typed directional boundary ports exist with fail-closed compatibility rules
Transfer values detached/immutable; no mutable child state exposed
Container-only scopes own no runtime participant
No direct cross-scope mutation path in the G4 seam
Failure semantics explicit and honest about lack of rollback
Mandatory regressions pass or anomalies honestly evidenced
Working tree clean and branch/head pushed
